name: Command R+
description: Enterprise-grade model optimized for RAG and tool use.
longDescription: Command R+ is Cohere's most powerful model designed for enterprise use cases. It excels at retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multi-step tool use, and structured outputs, with strong multilingual support across 10 languages.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import cohere

co = cohere.ClientV2(api_key="YOUR_COHERE_API_KEY")
response = co.chat(
    model="command-r-plus",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
print(response.message.content[0].text)
